recognize_zh: 穿刺切片（A、B）可見大型異型淋巴細胞瀰漫性片狀浸潤、核多形且深染；C–F 為瀰漫強陽性的膜/胞質染色、G–I 為核染色，符合免疫表型組合圖中的瀰漫性大B細胞淋巴瘤（DLBCL）。面板未標註抗體名稱，無法從圖中指認哪一格是 CD31。
features: Core biopsy with diffuse, sheet-like effacement by atypical lymphoid cells (A, x100)
Large cells with pleomorphic, hyperchromatic, irregular nuclei and scant to moderate cytoplasm; scattered crush artifact (B, x400)
Panels C-F: diffuse, strong membranous/cytoplasmic staining in nearly all tumor cells, sparing vessels
Panels G-I: nuclear stains of variable intensity and extent (G weak-moderate, H strong in many cells, I patchy)
Antibody names are not labeled on the panels, so specific markers (including CD31) cannot be assigned from the image
describe_en: Needle core biopsy shows diffuse effacement by sheets of large atypical lymphoid cells with pleomorphic, hyperchromatic nuclei (A, B). Immunohistochemistry panels show diffuse strong membranous/cytoplasmic reactivity in the tumor cells (C-F) and nuclear staining of variable extent (G-I); the individual antibodies are not labeled in this figure. Per the provided history, the tumor shows strong aberrant CD31 expression with an activated B-cell (non-germinal center) profile. Findings are consistent with diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, NOS, with aberrant CD31 expression.

ddx.vs: CD31 positivity may suggest a vascular neoplasm, but the discohesive lymphoid sheets with CD20/PAX5 and CD45 expression and absence of ERG/vasoformative channels support lymphoma.
ALCL shows hallmark cells with uniform strong CD30 and loss of B-cell antigens, whereas DLBCL expresses CD20/PAX5.
Carcinoma forms cohesive nests and is keratin-positive and CD45/CD20-negative.
Myeloid sarcoma consists of blasts with fine chromatin expressing MPO, CD117 or lysozyme rather than B-cell markers.
